title: 4-state FSM with enumerated state_type (synchronous, active-high reset)
problemDescription: Another small Moore FSM with 4 states {S0,S1,S2,S3} using an enumerated state_type. Synchronous, active-high reset; din toggles every 2 clock periods (20 ns). Exercises Kmila's user-defined-enum state register independently from case 008's std_logic_vector encoding.
